# Facilities Upstream from PFHpA Groundwater Contamination in Cumberland County

<!-- Generated by src/engine/queries/catalog.test.ts from src/constants/prebuiltQueries.ts. Do not edit by hand: run `npm test -- -u`. -->

> Given groundwater that tested positive for PFHpA (10-1000 ng/L) in Cumberland County, Maine, trace the river network back the other way: which facilities in the county sit upstream of that contamination, and are therefore candidate sources.

**ID**: `facilities-upstream-pfhpa-gw-cumberland`, one of the dashboard questions.

## Analysis question

| Part | Configuration |
| --- | --- |
| **Block A** | facilities, in Cumberland County, Maine |
| **Relationship** | Upstream |
| **Block C** | samples, in Cumberland County, Maine, substances PFHpA, material GW, 10 to 1000 ng/L |

## Pipeline steps

As the engine plans it today. Where a step receives identifiers from an earlier step, they appear
as `http://example.org/...` placeholders. The shared PREFIX block is left out; see
[docs/QUERIES.md](../QUERIES.md#prefixes).

| # | Step | Endpoint | Shown in the app as |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | `FIND_TARGET_IRIS` | `federation` | Finding samples with facilities upstream from them |
| 2 | `FIND_ANCHOR_IRIS` | `federation` | Finding facilities upstream from samples |
| 3 | `GET_FLOWLINE_GEOMETRIES` | `federation` | Loading upstream stream geometries |
| 4 | `HYDRATE_TARGET_BY_IRI` | `federation` | Loading details for samples |
| 5 | `HYDRATE_ANCHOR_BY_IRI` | `federation` | Loading details for facilities |
| 6 | `GET_REGION_BOUNDARIES` | `spatialkg` | Loading region boundaries |

## SPARQL

### Step 1: Finding samples with facilities upstream from them

```sparql
SELECT DISTINCT (?spC AS ?iri) WHERE {
  ?s2anchor rdf:type kwg-ont:S2Cell_Level13 .
  ?s2anchor spatial:connectedTo kwgr:administrativeRegion.USA.23005 .
  ?s2anchor kwg-ont:sfContains ?facilityA .
  ?facilityA fio:ofIndustry ?industryCodeA .
  ?industryCodeA a naics:NAICS-IndustryCode .

  ?s2anchor kwg-ont:sfTouches | owl:sameAs ?s2neighbor .
  ?s2neighbor spatial:connectedTo ?upstream_flowline .
  ?upstream_flowline rdf:type hyf:HY_FlowPath .
  ?upstream_flowline hyf:downstreamFlowPathTC ?ds_flowline .
  ?s2target spatial:connectedTo ?ds_flowline ;
            rdf:type kwg-ont:S2Cell_Level13 .
  ?s2target spatial:connectedTo kwgr:administrativeRegion.USA.23005 .
  ?spC rdf:type coso:SamplePoint ;
            spatial:connectedTo ?s2target .
  ?observationC coso:observedAtSamplePoint ?spC .
  ?observationC coso:ofDSSToxSubstance ?substanceC .
  ?observationC coso:analyzedSample ?sampleC .
  ?sampleC coso:sampleOfMaterialType ?matTypeC .
  ?observationC coso:hasResult ?resultC .
  OPTIONAL { ?resultC qudt:quantityValue/qudt:numericValue ?numericResultC }
  OPTIONAL { ?resultC qudt:quantityValue ?_qvC .
             ?_qvC rdf:type coso:NonDetectQuantityValue .
             BIND(true AS ?nonDetectC) }
  BIND(COALESCE(STR(?numericResultC),
         IF(BOUND(?nonDetectC), "non-detect", "non-quantified")) AS ?result_valueC)
  ?resultC coso:measurementUnit ?unitC .
  VALUES ?substanceC { <http://w3id.org/DSSTox/v1/DTXSID1037303> }
  VALUES ?matTypeC { <http://w3id.org/sawgraph/v1/me-egad#sampleMaterialType.GW> }
  BIND(xsd:decimal(?numericResultC) as ?numericValueC)
  FILTER((BOUND(?numericValueC) && ?unitC = <http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/NanoGM-PER-L> && ?numericValueC >= 10 && ?numericValueC <= 1000) || BOUND(?nonDetectC))

}
```

```sparql

  ?s2target spatial:connectedTo ?ds_flowline ;

  ?spC rdf:type coso:SamplePoint ;
            spatial:connectedTo ?s2target .
  ?observationC coso:observedAtSamplePoint ?spC .

  BIND(COALESCE(STR(?numericResultC),
         IF(BOUND(?nonDetectC), "non-detect", "non-quantified")) AS ?result_valueC)
  ?resultC coso:measurementUnit ?unitC .
  VALUES ?substanceC { <http://w3id.org/DSSTox/v1/DTXSID1037303> }
  VALUES ?matTypeC { <http://w3id.org/sawgraph/v1/me-egad#sampleMaterialType.GW> }
  BIND(xsd:decimal(?numericResultC) as ?numericValueC)
  FILTER((BOUND(?numericValueC) && ?unitC = <http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/NanoGM-PER-L> && ?numericValueC >= 10 && ?numericValueC <= 1000) || BOUND(?nonDetectC))
```

### Step 3: Loading upstream stream geometries

```sparql
SELECT DISTINCT ?flowline ?flowlineWKT ?fl_type ?streamName WHERE {
  {
    SELECT DISTINCT ?flowline WHERE {
      {
    SELECT DISTINCT ?s2cellus WHERE {
      VALUES ?facilityA { <http://example.org/anchor/1> <http://example.org/anchor/2> }

      ?s2anchor rdf:type kwg-ont:S2Cell_Level13 .
      ?s2anchor kwg-ont:sfContains ?facilityA .
  ?facilityA fio:ofIndustry ?industryCodeA .
  ?industryCodeA a naics:NAICS-IndustryCode .

      ?s2anchor kwg-ont:sfTouches | owl:sameAs ?s2cellus .
    }
  }
      ?upstream_flowline rdf:type hyf:HY_FlowPath ;
        spatial:connectedTo ?s2cellus ;
        hyf:downstreamFlowPathTC ?flowline .
    }
  }
  {
    SELECT DISTINCT ?flowline WHERE {
      {
        SELECT DISTINCT ?s2celltarget WHERE {
          VALUES ?spC { <http://example.org/target/1> <http://example.org/target/2> }

          ?s2celltarget rdf:type kwg-ont:S2Cell_Level13 .
          ?spC rdf:type coso:SamplePoint ;
            spatial:connectedTo ?s2celltarget .
        }
      }
      ?_flTarget spatial:connectedTo ?s2celltarget .
      ?flowline hyf:downstreamFlowPathTC ?_flTarget .
    }
  }
  ?flowline geo:hasGeometry/geo:asWKT ?flowlineWKT ;
            nhdplusv2:hasFTYPE ?fl_type .
  OPTIONAL { ?flowline rdfs:label ?streamName }
}
```

### Step 4: Loading details for samples

```sparql
SELECT
  (COUNT(DISTINCT ?observation) as ?resultCount)
  (COUNT(DISTINCT ?sample) as ?sampleCount)
  (MAX(?numericResult) as ?max)
  (GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ?substance; separator="; ") as ?substances)
  (GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ?matTypeLabel; separator="; ") as ?materials)
  (SAMPLE(?spName) as ?samplePointName)
  ?sp ?spWKT ?s2cell
WHERE {
  VALUES ?sp { <http://example.org/target/1> <http://example.org/target/2> }
  ?sp spatial:connectedTo ?s2cell ;
      geo:hasGeometry/geo:asWKT ?spWKT .
  OPTIONAL { ?sp rdfs:label ?spName }
  ?s2cell rdf:type kwg-ont:S2Cell_Level13 .
  ?observation rdf:type coso:ContaminantObservation ;
      coso:observedAtSamplePoint ?sp ;
      coso:ofDSSToxSubstance ?substance ;
      coso:analyzedSample ?sample ;
      coso:hasResult ?result .
  ?sample rdfs:label ?sampleLabel ;
      coso:sampleOfMaterialType ?matType .
  ?matType rdfs:label ?matTypeLabel .
  ?result coso:measurementUnit ?unit .
  OPTIONAL { ?result qudt:quantityValue/qudt:numericValue ?numericResult }
  OPTIONAL { ?result qudt:quantityValue ?_qv .
             ?_qv rdf:type coso:NonDetectQuantityValue .
             BIND(true AS ?nonDetect) }
  BIND(COALESCE(STR(?numericResult),
         IF(BOUND(?nonDetect), "non-detect", "non-quantified")) AS ?result_value)
  VALUES ?substance { <http://w3id.org/DSSTox/v1/DTXSID1037303> }
  VALUES ?matType { <http://w3id.org/sawgraph/v1/me-egad#sampleMaterialType.GW> }
  BIND(xsd:decimal(?numericResult) as ?numericValue)
  FILTER((BOUND(?numericValue) && ?unit = <http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/NanoGM-PER-L> && ?numericValue >= 10 && ?numericValue <= 1000) || BOUND(?nonDetect))

} GROUP BY ?sp ?spWKT ?s2cell
```

### Step 5: Loading details for facilities

```sparql
SELECT DISTINCT ?facility ?facWKT ?facilityName ?industryCode ?industryName ?s2cell WHERE {
  VALUES ?facility { <http://example.org/anchor/1> <http://example.org/anchor/2> }
  ?s2cell kwg-ont:sfContains ?facility ;
          rdf:type kwg-ont:S2Cell_Level13 .
  ?facility fio:ofIndustry ?industryCode ;
            geo:hasGeometry/geo:asWKT ?facWKT ;
            rdfs:label ?facilityName .
  ?industryCode a naics:NAICS-IndustryCode ;
                rdfs:label ?industryName .

}
```

### Step 6: Loading region boundaries

```sparql
SELECT ?region (SAMPLE(?_name) AS ?regionName) (SAMPLE(?_wkt) AS ?regionWKT) WHERE {
  ?region kwg-ont:administrativePartOf kwgr:administrativeRegion.USA.23 ;
          rdfs:label ?_name ;
          geo:hasGeometry/geo:asWKT ?_wkt .
  FILTER(STRSTARTS(STR(?region), STR(kwgr:)))
} GROUP BY ?region
```
